decision.question: Does the existing wide merge and direct terminal publication path save useful complete-job time for standalone Uniform at the exact native Linux 256 MiB tier?
decision.prior: Uniform to Balanced(8) sibling saved 16.74 and 6.97 s in two matched 8 GiB pairs. No standalone evidence.
decision.challenger: Add eligibility for singleton explicit Uniform, explicit 256 MiB, UTF-8 input and output on Linux. Existing one-worker, size, headroom, descriptor, plain-output and Auto grouping limits all apply. Leave 96 MiB eligibility limited to Uniform followed by Balanced.
decision.runtime: Ordinary WSL2 ext4 headroom, own timed user scope without a finite memory.max/high, no swap, warm uncontrolled cache. No concurrent CI or other timed jobs.
decision.timing: Start before GNU time/CLI launch through publication, cleanup and exit. Independent verification and fixture work are outside the timer.
decision.decision_rule: All records verified including seven strict-cap CSVs; both first pairs must save time to run the third. All three paired elapsed savings positive and median >=5 seconds to consider qualification; median CPU <=1.15x baseline. Baseline snapshot, challenger wide and private; equal initial runs, fewer merges and fewer managed read/write bytes in each pair.
decision.termination: Stop on correctness, cleanup, route/hypothesis or resource failure. Stop after two timed pairs if either misses. No larger/different cohort without a reviewed new question.
decision.prior_attempt: 1 GiB hard cgroup baseline failed shared admission before publication. Default Linux headroom accounts uncredited cgroup file cache. Separate the initial failed receipt from this ordinary-host comparison.

decision.prior: Combined wide merge and private terminal output saved 9.2 to 12.3 seconds in the three matched ordinary WSL pairs. The wide route denied a real encoding sink with the same 530512996-byte late peer that allowed the old path.
decision.challenger: Keep the default 64-way sorter and select existing private terminal publication for one Linux plain UTF-8 standalone explicit Uniform at 8 GiB+, with fixed 256 MiB, one resolved worker, Auto grouping, and 256 MiB of tracked shared headroom.
decision.runtime: Ordinary WSL2 ext4 headroom, own timed user scope without a finite memory.max/high, no swap, warm uncontrolled cache. No concurrent CI or other timed jobs.

Both arms have the same sort run count, merge count and peak merge fan-in, with reduced managed temporary reads and writes in the challenger.
